scripts.check: cargo check --workspace && bun run --cwd apps/web check && bun apps/web/scripts/ui-lint.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: bun run --cwd apps/web build && cargo build -p soloops-server --example e2e_harness --features e2e-harness && playwright test
scripts.build: cargo build --workspace --release && bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.format: cargo fmt --all && prettier --write apps/web README.md docs
scripts.format:check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && prettier --check apps/web README.md docs
